away.summary: The Blues are 1-0-0 after a 4-0 win over the Stars. They will use a projected lineup with Jordan Binnington expected to start in goal. Key absences include Logan Mailloux (hand), Tyler Tucker (knee), and Alexey Toropchenko (upper body), with Zach Dean and Justin Barron scratched. Mason McTavish is a new addition via trade and is expected to play on the second line.

home.summary: The Avalanche are 1-0-0 and will use a projected lineup with Mackenzie Blackwood expected to start in goal. They will dress 11 forwards and seven defensemen. Logan O’Connor and Zachary L’Heureux are both day-to-day with lower-body injuries. No players are scratched. Coach Jared Bednar recently signed a four-year contract extension through 2030-31.
